retrievalProfile.description: A vertical portrait centered within a wide, solid-colored border, featuring thin, stacked geometric typography in the upper corner.
triggerTerms: centered vertical photo with wide blue border

recipe.visualDefinition: A centered vertical rectangular photograph of a person, framed by a wide, solid-colored matte border. The typography is placed in the upper-left corner of the image area, characterized by extremely thin, light strokes and tight vertical stacking.
coreVisualRelationships: Wide solid border framing a central vertical image
Thin geometric typography nested in the image corner
Soft, diffused lighting on the central subject
Muted, earthy tones in the photo contrasting with a vibrant border

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered vertical subject, medium shot, occupying the central third of the total width.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the high-contrast typography in the upper corner.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the top-left text, down to the subject's face, then following the vertical line of the body.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Substantial negative space provided by the wide, solid-colored outer border.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep periwinkle or royal blue for the outer border.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: White and light grey in the photo background and clothing.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted magenta and pink stripes on the subject's shirt.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation border surrounding a lower-saturation, film-grain photograph.
paletteRestrictions: Maintain a 1970s muted film palette for the photo

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Geometric sans-serif with circular curves and straight stems.

composition.position: Top-left corner of the photo inset

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family used for both name and title with slight size variation.

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: ITC Avant Garde Gothic Extra Light
candidateDirections.reason: Captures the geometric 70s aesthetic and thin stroke.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a vertical portrait of a person in 1970s attire, centered in a wide, solid blue rectangular frame with a soft film grain texture.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add four lines of left-aligned, uppercase, hairline geometric sans-serif text in the top-left corner of the inner photo.

verificationChecks: Is the photo centered within a wide solid border?
Is the lighting soft and vintage-inspired?

adjustableVariables: Text color (black vs white depending on photo background)
mustRedesign: Do not use the specific artist name or album title
Do not replicate the exact facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text does not touch the edges of the photo inset.
Confirm the border is a single solid color without gradients.
Check that the film grain is subtle and uniform.
Verify the typography is perfectly left-aligned.
recipe.reuseFormula: Take a vertical portrait, place it in a solid color frame that occupies 50% of the total width, and add hairline geometric text in the top-left corner.
